manifest.name: Zombie leader (SIGSTOP)
manifest.description: Leader b1 is paused (GC pause / SIGSTOP) for 15s. The controller fences it and elects b2 with a new leader epoch. When b1 wakes up it still believes it leads. It first works through its socket buffer: it appends and acknowledges (acks=1) the produce request that was waiting there, then applies the new metadata, becomes a follower and truncates to the log of the new leader. That acknowledged batch is lost. Leader epochs keep the replicas consistent, but they cannot rescue an acks=1 write.
